title: The four tiers
desc: Each change gets a tier from the files it touches. Tier 1, a small fix, needs locked tests. Tier 2, a normal change, adds an approved plan and a review. Tollgate can merge tiers 1 and 2 itself. Tier 3, login, payments, or user data, and tier 4, the test setup, the settings, or production, add a security review, and you merge them.

nodes.text:
A small fix
Locked tests.
Tollgate merges it.

A normal change
+ a plan and a review.
Tollgate merges it.

Login, payments, data
+ a security review.
You merge it.

Test setup, settings
+ a security review.
You merge it.
